name: Warm and hazy
story: The high at its peak: the warmest day of the fortnight, a milky haze over the far hills, cumulus building over the ridges in the afternoon. Short strips feel a little shorter.
forecast: Warm, 23-24 C at sea level in the afternoon. Haze, visibility 20 km. Cumulus over the hills from 13:00, base 1800 m. Wind light and variable, sea breeze southwest 8 kt. Mild night, a few clouds, the moon through haze.
